zeroshot_eval_report_json_is_from_an OLD.conclusion: this eval report predates the fingerprint field and the 7-resolution list, i.e. it is older than the other two.

the_check_that_settles_it.why_the_manifest_was_not_enough: it has no train entry for this case.
the_check_that_settles_it.what_settles_it_instead: file modification times order the events directly, whatever the manifest recorded.
the_check_that_settles_it.command: import os, datetime; D='/content/drive/MyDrive/pfem_run/zeroshot_B1_neo_hookean/'; [print('%-32s %s' % (f, datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(os.path.getmtime(D+f)))) for f in sorted(os.listdir(D)) if f.endswith(('.json','.pt'))]
the_check_that_settles_it.how_to_read_it: if metrics_history.json (the JOINT history) is NEWER than zeroshot_eval_report.json, the joint training came after the eval -> reading A: Table 12's caption stands and only an eval re-run is needed. If it is OLDER, the eval was run on the joint model -> reading B: the caption is wrong.

why_this_matters_beyond_a_caption: under reading A the remaining work for a uniform three-case B1 table is one eval run, not a retrain. Under reading B it is already done and only the report text is wrong. Either way it is cheap -- but the report currently makes a claim about how a model was trained, and that claim is either right or it is not.
provenance: the metrics_history first entry and the training summary were printed from Drive on 2026-08-29; the eval report contents were listed the same day.

manifest_read_2026_08_29.what_it_does_NOT_contain: no zeroshot_generate and no zeroshot_train entry at all.
manifest_read_2026_08_29.what_that_means: the training that produced this directory's joint metrics_history.json was never recorded, so it predates the run_manifest instrumentation. The manifest therefore cannot order train against eval by itself.
manifest_read_2026_08_29.but_it_narrows_things: B1 x Mooney-Rivlin and B1 x Arruda-Boyce BOTH have zeroshot_train entries dated 2026-08-28. If B1 x Neo-Hookean had been retrained jointly as part of that same six-case sweep, its train would have been recorded too. It is not. That points to the joint training being OLD -- older than the 2026-08-27 evals -- which is reading B, the caption being wrong. It is an inference from an absence, not a measurement, so it does not close the question.
manifest_read_2026_08_29.new_fact_worth_keeping: two pareto_analysis runs on 2026-08-28 (01:30 and 05:00) and two zeroshot_eval runs on 2026-08-27 (15:36 and 21:11). The Pareto for this case is confirmed to have run, twice, consistent with Table 18 being in the report.
